narration:
It's been an honor helping you forge Alden! You've crafted a steadfast protector, a soldier who has traded the rigid life of a guard for a calling to shield the innocent. Your history as a soldier and your kind heart will surely serve you well as you step into the wilds of Thornwood.

Here is your completed character sheet. Please review it carefully to ensure every detail of Alden is exactly as you imagined.

***
**NAME:** Alden
**RACE:** Human
**CLASS:** Fighter (Level 1)
**BACKGROUND:** Soldier
**ALIGNMENT:** Lawful Good
**PERSONALITY:** A kind former guard who protects travelers.

**ABILITIES:**
STR: 16 (+3) | DEX: 12 (+1) | CON: 14 (+2)
INT: 10 (+0) | WIS: 13 (+1) | CHA: 8 (-1)

**COMBAT STATS:**
HP: 12/12 | AC: 18 (Chain Mail + Shield + Defense Style)
Initiative: +1 | Speed: 30ft
Proficiency Bonus: +2

**ATTACKS:**
Longsword: +5 to hit | 1d8 + 3 slashing

**SKILLS & PROFICIENCIES:**
Proficient Skills: Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, Survival
Saving Throws: Strength, Constitution
Armor: All Armor, Shields
Weapons: Simple Weapons, Martial Weapons
Tools: Gaming Set
Languages: Common, one additional language (Human default)

**FEATURES:**
Fighting Style (Defense): +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor.
Second Wind: Use a bonus action to regain 1d10 + 1 HP (1/short rest).
Military Rank: Soldiers from your organization still recognize your authority.

**EQUIPMENT:**
Chain Mail, Longsword, Shield, Explorer's Pack, 10 Gold Pieces
***
